description: Global parameter registry for KMRL railway certification document processing. Used as RAG retrieval context and deterministic validation rules.

parameters.name: Wheel Diameter
parameters.description: Worn wheel tread diameter measured at flange reference point

parameters.name: Brake Pad Thickness
parameters.description: Minimum remaining friction material thickness on composite brake pads

parameters.name: Bogie Frame Crack Length
parameters.description: Maximum allowable fatigue crack length on bogie frame weldments via MPI/UT

parameters.name: Axle Bearing Temperature
parameters.description: Peak operating temperature of axle box bearing under load

parameters.name: Traction Motor Insulation Resistance
parameters.description: Insulation resistance of traction motor windings measured at 500V DC

parameters.name: Pantograph Contact Force
parameters.description: Static uplift force of pantograph carbon strip on OHE contact wire

parameters.name: Coupler Height
parameters.description: Centre height of automatic coupler from rail level

parameters.name: Suspension Spring Deflection
parameters.description: Secondary suspension vertical deflection under tare weight

parameters.name: Door Opening Force
parameters.description: Maximum force required to manually open passenger sliding door

parameters.name: HVAC Cooling Capacity
parameters.description: Rated cooling output per saloon HVAC package unit

parameters.name: Wheel Flange Thickness
parameters.description: Flange thickness measured 10mm below flange tip

parameters.name: Air Spring Pressure
parameters.description: Secondary air spring operating pressure under tare load

parameters.name: ATP Response Time
parameters.description: Time from ATP trigger to emergency brake command application

parameters.name: Balise Read Accuracy
parameters.description: Percentage of successful balise telegram reads over test distance

parameters.name: Odometer Drift
parameters.description: Cumulative position error as percentage over 10km calibration run

parameters.name: Cab Signal Display Brightness
parameters.description: Luminance of DMI display under direct sunlight test condition

parameters.name: Train-to-Wayside Communication Latency
parameters.description: Round-trip latency of CBTC radio communication link

parameters.name: Axle Counter Reset Accuracy
parameters.description: Track vacancy detection accuracy after conditional reset

parameters.name: Speed Sensor Accuracy
parameters.description: Speed measurement accuracy across full operational range

parameters.name: Fire Detection Response Time
parameters.description: Time from fire ignition to alarm activation per EN 45545

parameters.name: Emergency Brake Distance
parameters.description: Stopping distance from 80 km/h on level dry rail

parameters.name: Door Interlock Holding Force
parameters.description: Force required to defeat powered door interlock mechanism

parameters.name: Emergency Lighting Duration
parameters.description: Battery-backed emergency lighting endurance after power loss

parameters.name: Smoke Obscuration
parameters.description: Maximum smoke density obscuration per metre in evacuation corridor

parameters.name: Deadman Device Response Time
parameters.description: Time from driver incapacitation to automatic emergency brake

parameters.name: Crashworthiness Longitudinal Force
parameters.description: Peak longitudinal compressive force endured by end structure per EN 15227

parameters.name: Earthing Resistance
parameters.description: Resistance between car body metalwork and running rail return circuit

parameters.name: Emergency Egress Door Width
parameters.description: Clear opening width of emergency detrainment doors

parameters.name: PSD-Train Door Alignment Tolerance
parameters.description: Longitudinal misalignment between platform screen door and train door
